concepts.gloss_en: soul (nefesh); the animating life-force / lowest of the soul-levels (nefesh-ruach-neshama)

reason_for_human: All 32 singular occurrences are vocalized נֶפֶשׁ and consistently mean 'soul/life-force' (paired as bechina with dibbur, ratzon, lev, nekeva, ner, etc.); the 2 plural נְפָשׁוֹת occurrences ('souls are aspect of stones', 'these are the souls') are the plain plural of the same word. Singular↔plural is inflection, not a homograph, so the merge is correct. No competing sense (e.g. 'person/corpse') appears here.
